Web functions: browser relay return. Current backend route source is bound in backend_sources. Not an app callback. Signed state completion then 302 relative browser return to ../../integrations or ../../settings; src/oauth/routes.py:135. Internal surface has no consumer compatibility promise. Mutating single-use completion: a valid matched pending state is popped before denial/provider-error/missing-code handling, so those outcomes and exchange failure consume the attempt too. Successful completion exchanges the provider code, persists tokens and invalidates provider data; never replay automatically. src/oauth/service.py:730–775,829–850.

Conservative explicit replay because this GET can trigger provider work, not merely return stored state.
